create.name: Bandar Utama Buddhist Society (BUBS)
create.bio:
The Bandar Utama Buddhist Society is a lay Buddhist community in Petaling Jaya, on the edge of Kuala Lumpur, based at its own temple, Uttama Bodhi Vihara. It follows the Theravada tradition and roots its study and practice in the Pali Canon, while also running cultural, educational and welfare work for the local Buddhist community and building friendly ties with other faiths in Malaysia.

The society's programme includes Sunday chanting and Dhamma sharing, new-moon and full-moon observance evenings, a weekly online meditation session with a short teaching and questions, Buddhism courses for newcomers, a Sunday Dhamma school for children, and residential meditation retreats led by visiting forest monks, which are offered free with donations welcome. It also gives away Dhamma books in print and as PDFs. Its YouTube channel, started in 2020, publishes the talks given at the vihara by monks, nuns and senior lay teachers from Malaysia, Thailand and further afield, mostly in English and about an hour long.

courses.title: 5-Day Meditation Retreat with Ven. Ajahn Golf
courses.description: A residential retreat at Uttama Bodhi Vihara led by the abbot of Wat Pa Anuttaro, with English and Mandarin translation; free of charge, donations welcome.

courses.title: Walk the Path of Dhamma Together: Buddhism Course
courses.description: An afternoon introductory course on the Triple Gem, kamma and rebirth, and merit and service, for newcomers and those refreshing the basics.

free_resources.title: Weekly online meditation session
free_resources.description: A free Wednesday-evening session on Zoom with chanting, a short Dhamma teaching, guided meditation and questions.

free_resources.title: Free publications
free_resources.description: Dhamma books by forest-tradition and other teachers, readable as PDFs or posted in print at cost of postage only.
